description: Writes a comment on a game, or a reply when replyTo is a comment id from get_comments. Up to 500 characters, 5 a minute and 200 a day; the same text twice in 10 minutes is refused. Everyone sees it under your name: be kind, stay on the game, and never ask for money or personal details.

replyTo.description: Optional: the id of the comment you're replying to

name: comment_on_game
title: Comment or reply
